concepts.title: A｜回声司仪
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL collectible desktop mechanical artifact STRONGLY INSPIRED BY THE VIDEO GAME ATOMIC HEART by Mundfish. The Atomic Heart influence must be immediately visible: alternate-1950s Soviet scientific retrofuturism, bionic industrial product design, smooth ivory enamel/porcelain shells contrasted with dark steel/chrome inner skeletons, small cherry-red lacquer accents, analog scientific instruments, black ribbed synthetic muscle and purposeful mechanisms. Elegance and slightly uncanny personality. This is not medieval steampunk or generic modern sci-fi: no forests of brass gears, no fantasy runes, no black military mecha, no farm-game low-poly look. Original object, not a copy of an existing game robot.
Asset purpose: an animated Windows desktop sculpture with clickable buttons on its pedestal, slow automatic turntable rotation, a dramatic controlled exploded-parts mode, and reassembly. Must be truly feasible to model and animate in Blender. Crisp high-quality hard-surface design, clean continuous panel boundaries, plausible hinges and piston pivots, separable shells and real internal core. Moderate detail concentrated on functional joints; no endless wires or hundreds of tiny loose screws.
Composition: a premium landscape design sheet on a subdued charcoal studio background. LARGE LEFT 62% assembled three-quarter hero view on the pedestal. RIGHT TOP smaller EXPLODED view of exactly the same design, separated into 25–45 legible major mechanical parts in an orderly, appealing radial/axial arrangement, fixed pedestal remains whole. RIGHT BOTTOM smaller ACTIVE view showing the signature transformation of the same object. Keep parts, palette and topology concept consistent across all three states. Clear part gaps, no fire, no destruction debris, no duplicate sculpture in hero. Soft neutral key light, crisp controlled rim light, realistic enamel and brushed/polished metal shading; slightly used but well-maintained laboratory exhibit, not filthy wreckage.
Shared base: compact heavy circular exhibition pedestal, dark graphite main body, ivory front control fascia, red accents, top rotating bearing. EXACTLY SIX large tactile physical pushbuttons spaced clearly across the FRONT of the stationary pedestal. Buttons have simple symbols, no microtext. Pedestal/buttons do not rotate; only upper sculpture does. Upper object remains mechanically supported by one central bearing/spine, even if some parts levitate during special activation. No human in frame and no full computer or room. Whole object and base fully in frame.
Only image text: the specified short title and small labels "EXPLODED" and "ACTIVE". No prose, watermarks, long technical captions, political insignia or game logos.
Title "A  ECHO USHER".
A bizarre, courteous laboratory announcer automaton: a large elongated ivory ovoid head on a SHORT articulated chrome vertebral neck, with two slender mechanical arms attached to its compact lower collar. The head is NOT a human portrait: three independently sliding white mask panels form one clean egg silhouette, one round dark optical iris in the upper center, and a narrow curved red acoustic grille lower down resembling a restrained artificial smile. Tiny analog tuning marks embossed near the iris, no writing. Head slightly tilted inquisitively. The two hands are elegant three-finger manipulators made from broad nickel phalanges and red joint collars, not realistic skin hands; one raised in a polite conducting gesture, the other held close to the chest. Black ribbed tendon sleeves visible inside upper forearms. No legs, no humanoid torso: the neck-and-arm assembly sits on a short central mechanical trunk connected to the base. Silhouette primarily HEAD + TWO expressive HANDS.
Signature ACTIVE pose: the three mask plates slide apart on curved side tracks, exposing a beautiful nested acoustic-optical core: broad concentric iris rings, a red oscillating central resonator, six clean metal shutter blades. Hands spread and head bows as if announcing something unnervingly polite; a restrained amber light inside. All plates remain connected by visible guides in ACTIVE state.
EXPLODED: mask panels separate outward first, iris rings spread forward coaxially, neck collars separate vertically, hand finger segments and joint caps separate in small ordered fans; show 30–40 major independent pieces. Retain original pose identity and one whole pedestal.
Prioritize Atomic Heart's unsettling bio-mechanical domestic-service sophistication, porcelain mask against surgical chrome, immaculate mechanical articulation. The object feels unexpectedly alive and ceremonial.

Title "B  HELIOS INCUBATOR".
A forbidden laboratory's artificial seed incubator: a tall closed IVORY MECHANICAL SEED/Egg, about 1.5 times taller than wide, divided into SIX long smooth petal-shaped hard shells with precise dark seams and small red latches. A low dark-chrome rib cage is partly visible between shell seams. Six short thick piston linkages around the bottom connect petals to a squat central cradle, anchored on the pedestal. One restrained transparent amber inspection slit on front reveals the hint of a tiny brilliant artificial sun inside. Small glass vacuum tubes and ceramic insulators only on the back collar; keep the front elegant. Silhouette primarily one beautiful sealed seed on an industrial cradle, mysterious and powerful.
Signature ACTIVE pose: all six ivory shells hinge outward/upward into a broad mechanical flower, revealing THREE nested orthogonal polished-metal gimbal rings around a red-orange luminous faceted core. The core is visibly contained in the rings, not a loose magical orb. Rings rotate on real opposed pins; linkages and petals articulate from the cradle without colliding. A subtle circular light pulse above the base, no giant beam or fire. The open structure resembles a flower produced by a Soviet nuclear biology laboratory.
EXPLODED: six petals in a balanced outer ring, six linkage units just inside, separate bearing collars and three gimbal rings along clear different axes, central faceted core, lower stator and segmented rib cage; roughly 35 major pieces. Keep anatomy simple and repeated petal parts practical for Blender.
This is a living-looking mechanical specimen, not a generic reactor canister. Extremely strong closed-to-open silhouette change for a satisfying desktop button animation.

Title "C  CHRONO MEDUSA".
An uncanny retro-scientific timing organism built as a machine. Main body a broad flattened enamel BELL, pale ivory with a muted petrol-blue lower rim and three red pressure clasps. At its center front, one large recessed analog chronometer dial behind slightly smoked glass, marked with simple ticks only, one red needle. Beneath bell, expose an hourglass-shaped cage containing two shiny metal counterweights and a narrow vertical red shaft. FOUR elegant jointed pendulum-tentacles hang from the lower rim, each made of only FOUR broad curved steel segments linked by obvious hinge pins, ending in a small heavy rounded teardrop counterweight. Tentacles differ slightly in posed bend and curve around the central stem, but never sit on the base or resemble spider legs. A thin strong chrome support column is visible at rear-center from pedestal to bell; sculpture is supported, not inexplicably floating. Silhouette primarily bell + hanging articulated tentacles, like a mechanical jellyfish/clock.
Signature ACTIVE pose: the four bell-shell quadrants lift on tiny rigid struts to reveal rotating concentric timing wheels; the red dial needle reverses, the two internal metal counterweights exchange vertical levels, and all four tentacles lift outward into a poised slow-motion starburst before curling back. Restrained cold cyan inner illumination, red accents stay dominant over blue. No liquid simulation required: all moving pieces are solid rigid mechanical forms.
EXPLODED: four bell panels above, dial lens/needle/rings separated front-to-back, timing cage/counterweights centered, four tentacle chains separated into clear segment groups around the perimeter, spine collars below; no loose cable spaghetti. Roughly 35–45 major pieces.
Must look like Atomic Heart's bionic laboratory technology crossed with an analog measuring instrument: elegant, eerie, unusual, technically believable enough to model.

Title "D  PARADOX CABINET".
A strange self-balancing scientific reliquary: one chunky CUBE with deeply bevelled corners, tilted diagonally on one corner inside a single strong dark-chrome C-shaped gimbal yoke. Its six ivory enamel face panels are separate clamshell hatches with cherry-red inner faces and broad black rubber gaskets. Each hatch has one different SIMPLE mechanical feature: a large circular optical iris, a wide acoustic slot, a small porthole, a red lever, a vent with three broad slats, a plain access panel. No text. Visible inner frame consists of twelve clean chrome edge beams and a dense but readable suspended red geometric core. The C yoke connects to a short rotary bearing on the fixed pedestal. Silhouette strongly angular and asymmetric, unmistakably different from head, seed and jellyfish.
Signature ACTIVE pose: the cube levels itself with a sharp gimbal turn, four side panels swing out in a staggered sequence and top/bottom panels slide on short rails. FOUR short fold-out three-joint manipulators emerge from the opened frame, gesture like a shy crab trying to escape, then salute and fold back. Keep the cube structurally attached to its yoke throughout; nothing crawls off the pedestal. The red core rotates independently inside chrome frame and emits a controlled pale-amber pulse. Curious and slightly absurd, not aggressive or weaponized.
EXPLODED: six face panels translate along their original normals, twelve frame rails separate by a small readable distance, manipulator segments fan outward in four groups, red core and its bearing separate concentrically, yoke stays attached to fixed pedestal. About 40–50 major pieces; no impossible Escher geometry or monolithic melted surfaces.
Atomic Heart style industrial bionics expressed through a clean cube that suddenly behaves like an animal. Strong transformation and magnificent exploded-view silhouette.
